description: A transnational civil society coalition, the 'Human Futures Movement', gains momentum across EU member states, demanding a moratorium on AI-driven public sector automation and calling for a European Citizens' Assembly on AI. Fueled by the backlash against job losses and data centre construction, it organizes mass town halls and digital forums, framing AI not as infrastructure but as a societal transformation requiring democratic legitimacy. The movement begins influencing national policy debates and pressures EU institutions to convene formal deliberative processes.
